newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Jan 22.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on January 22. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A Philippine government wage panel approved a 20-peso increase in minimum wages for private sector employees in Metro Manila (Business World, Manila Bulletin, Today, Manila Times, The Business Daily, Manila Chronicle)

_ Philippine police said they have shot shot dead three alleged members of an international drug-running gang, including a Hong Kong Chinese citizen and a Taiwanese, in Manila's Makati business district (THE PHILIPPINE STAR)
- A new group led by a self-proclaimed human rights lawyer said it will launch a movement to push Philippine First Lady Amelita Ramos to run for president in 1998 (TODAY)
- Three Dutch financial institutions led by ING Bank are syndicating a $110 million term loan facility for Pilipino Telephone Corp (BUSINESSWORLD).
- The Department of Energy proposed to President Fidel Ramos a full oil industry deregulation on February 8 (BUSINESS DAILY).
